title: Middle Distance Races and Montage
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Races on a measured track; montage from old magazines of athletes.

skills.key_step: The child says middle distance races are the 800 m and 1 500 m, needing even pace, endurance and tactics, and a montage combines many pictures on a theme.

floor.question: Where must the baton be passed?

steps: Say what the runner needs: pace and endurance.
contexts: Kenyan athletes in the 800 m and 1 500 m

board.do: Write the two races and what they need.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a middle distance race?
misconceptions.repair: Sort 100, 400, 800, 1 500 and 5 000 m into sprint, middle and long.
Show a montage of runners cut from newspapers.

misconceptions.ask: What do middle distance runners need?
misconceptions.repair: Run 800 m flat out versus at an even pace; compare the last lap.

misconceptions.ask: In the 800 m, do runners stay in lanes all the way?
misconceptions.repair: Watch an 800 m start: they cut in after the break line.

checks.question: What do middle distance runners need most?
